maya: Quick async standup — SDKs + sample apps (what I did / blockers / today)

jonathan: Published node SDK v0.4.1 with the ESM import fix. CI green except macOS wheels flaky on 3/3 jobs. :tada:

maya: Great, thanks! Can you add a short changelog entry and call out the ESM workaround? Also we still need a tiny test for the import case.

sam: Blocked on sampleapp auth flow — local dev proxy returns 502 when Origin header present. Repro steps: start proxy + app, auth popup redirects -> fetch to /api/token returns 502. PR #511 is where I pushed the change.

lee: I can pick that up later today — putting it on my list. @sam can you paste the failing request log here?

sam: sure, dropping the log:
```
POST /api/token HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Origin: http://localhost:3000
User-Agent: curl/7.79.1
Content-Length: 123

{
  "code": "..."
}

Response: 502 Bad Gateway
Upstream: proxy -> auth-service timeout
```

jonathan: FYI i'm planning a quick rollback if mac wheel flakes keep failing tonight. Ping me if you need coordination for the node release window.

alice: Docs update: refreshed Python quickstart to show venv usage and the new REDWOOD_API_URL env var. Opened docs PR #482. Also added a note about streaming tokens.

maya: Thanks @alice — left a couple tiny nits on the PR. Can you add a brief streaming snippet (async for token in stream:) so it's obvious in examples?

alice: yep will add a minimal streaming snippet and push an amendment.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy to staging scheduled at 18:00 UTC. Details: https://deploys.redwood.ai/canary/25321

maya: Today: follow up on changelog, review alice's PR, pair with @lee on sampleapp auth. Blockers: none beyond sam's proxy issue.

lee: Today: triage @sam proxy, add failing case test to sampleapp, try to repro mac wheel locally. Blocker: need mac-builder access (ticket #923).

sam: Thanks — uploaded full request/response traces to the attachments thread (https://files.redwood.ai/att/511). If anyone wants to pair on repro, ping me.

jonathan: :thumbsup: i'll wait for changelog update then merge the node SDK PR and tag the release.

maya: Awesome. If nothing else urgent, i'll close this thread after reviews land.
